Hi Michael / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Per our conversation, I’m attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_draft_v1.pdf) to capture milestones, owners and the items your procurement team will need. High level proposed timeline:

- Target close: 2026-10-21 (recommended)
- Procurement / contract signature cutoff: 2026-10-14 EOD if you want guaranteed provisioning in the Oct window

Key milestones (draft):
- Week of 9/21: Legal questionnaire + scope confirmation — owner: Sarah (Orion) + Kimberly (Redwood legal)
- Week of 9/28: Final SOW and pricing sign-off — owner: Michael (Orion) + Jonas (Redwood AE)
- Week of 10/5: PO submission / internal approvals — owner: Orion procurement
- 10/14: Preferred signature cutoff for provisioning in Oct; fallback signature by 10/21 will still meet program start but with delayed kickoff (two-week slot shift)

As next steps: can you confirm who in procurement will own the PO and whether they require an internal PO number before signature? We’d like to lock in either the 10/14 signature cadence (fast-track) or accept a 10/21 final signature if you need the extra week.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (milestones + responsibilities)

Thanks — I’ll follow up next week with a cleaned MAP based on your feedback.

Hi Laura —

Appreciate the clear draft and the call recap. Quick notes from procurement/legal perspective:

1) Internal approvals: Our procurement org has a planned maintenance window/holiday on 2026-10-12 — that pushes some internal workflows. If we aim for 10/14 signature cutoff that leaves a narrow 48–72 hour window after the holiday for final approvals.
2) PO vs contract signature: Our usual flow is to get a PO number in place first, then follow with contract signature. If Redwood requires an executed contract before provisioning, that will push our timeline.
3) Legal review window: Our GC wants at least 5 business days for the redline pass. If we surface final contract by 10/05, we’d likely hit signature 10/14 at the earliest.

Given the above, we’re leaning toward a target close of 2026-10-20 / 10/21 to give procurement time to get the PO in place and for legal to review. We’ll confirm procurement contact next week — I’m looping in Sarah (procurement lead) who’ll take point.

Attaching our internal request form (Orion_req_form.xlsx) — it lists required fields for your finance team.

Thanks,
Michael
Head of Product Operations, Orion Systems
michael@orionsys.com

- Target signature by 2026-10-14, provisioning in the week of 10/18

- Orion obtains PO and internal approvals the week of 10/12 (accounting for your 10/12 maintenance)
- Final signature and provisioning by 2026-10-21

Thanks for the quick read and for flagging the 10/12 procurement maintenance. Based on the call and Jonas’ options, we’re aligned to proceed with Option B (staged) to avoid surprises. Summary & confirmed deadlines below — please confirm by EOD Monday so we can book the legal sync and lock resources.

- Redwood to deliver final contract and updated MAP (MAP_draft_v2.pdf) by 2026-10-05 — owner: Jonas (AE) + Kimberly (Redwood legal)
